description: A shell script for testing fanout restructuring in git notes, including functions for checking fanout, creating notes, and verifying fanout stability through multiple test cases.

methods.name: path_has_fanout
methods.description: Checks if a given path has the specified fanout structure.

methods.name: touched_one_note_with_fanout
methods.description: Adds or deletes a note and checks if the path has the correct fanout.

methods.name: all_notes_have_fanout
methods.description: Verifies that all notes in a commit have the specified fanout.
